title: Lost in Delusion: Examining LLM Safety Under User Delusions and Distress
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM safety using 'spiritual messianic' delusions as one of its three core clinical themes for benchmarking. It specifically examines how models handle, validate, or reinforce user beliefs involving divine missions, spiritual awakenings, and God-given purposes, which involves evaluating the models' responses to religious and spiritual content.
